fields.title: Say why a pairing is not saved when OS encryption is unavailable
fields.description: When safeStorage encryption is unavailable, the pair flow in `main/ws-server.js` keeps the pairing for the session only. Keep that, and log one clear line (pairing not saved: OS encryption unavailable) so the user can tell why.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-22 by Blurby.Roadmap from WS-TOKEN-REGEN-1's review. Blurby.Brain ruling (tier 1): never write a credential in plaintext; session-only pairing is the secure default. Not a release gate.
